════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
              📋 DEPLOYMENT CHECKLIST - OTHER RASPBERRY PIs
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

✅ YES/NO: Do I need to extract the tar file?
   Answer: ❌ NO! Docker 'load' command reads tar directly.
   
✅ YES/NO: Do I need to run a setup script?
   Answer: ❌ NO! Everything is automatic.
   
✅ YES/NO: Do I need to install dependencies?
   Answer: ❌ NO! All included in Docker image.

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                       ⚡ SIMPLEST DEPLOYMENT (4 COMMANDS)
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. Load image:
   $ docker load -i rpi4-app-image.tar

2. Start app:
   $ cd app && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d

3. Wait 5 seconds, then check:
   $ docker ps

4. Open browser:
   http://NEW_RPI_IP:11078

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                     💻 COPY-PASTE COMPLETE COMMANDS
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

FROM DEV MACHINE - Transfer files to new RPi:
───────────────────────────────────────────────
scp rpi4-app-image.tar pi-user@NEW_RPI_IP:/home/pi/
scp docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml pi-user@NEW_RPI_IP:/home/pi/app/

ON NEW RPi - Load and run:
───────────────────────────
ssh pi-user@NEW_RPI_IP
docker load -i ~/rpi4-app-image.tar
docker images | grep rpi4-app  # verify it loaded
cd ~/app
docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d
docker ps  # check it's running
docker logs -f rdk-middleware-dashboard  # watch logs

IN BROWSER:
─────────
http://NEW_RPI_IP:11078

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                 🎯 WHAT THE KEY FILES DO - NO SETUP NEEDED
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

rpi4-app-image.tar (1.2 GB)
├─ What: Compressed Docker image
├─ Action: docker load -i rpi4-app-image.tar
├─ Result: Prepares 'rpi4-app:latest' image
└─ ✅ Docker handles everything - just load and go!

docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml
├─ What: Configuration to run the container
├─ Action: docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d
├─ Result: Starts container with proper settings
└─ ✅ Everything automated - no manual config!

docker-entrypoint.sh
├─ What: Startup script (INSIDE Docker image)
├─ When: Runs automatically when container starts
├─ Does: Initializes Flask app + Gunicorn server
└─ ✅ You do nothing - runs automatically!

app.py
├─ What: Main Flask web application (INSIDE Docker image)
├─ When: Runs automatically via entrypoint
├─ Location: /app/app.py (inside container)
└─ ✅ You do nothing - starts automatically!

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                      ✅ CONTAINER STARTUP SEQUENCE
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

What happens after you run 'docker-compose up -d':

1. Docker reads docker-compose.yml configuration
2. Creates persistent volumes (app_data, reference_screens)
3. Starts container from rpi4-app:latest image
4. Runs /app/docker-entrypoint.sh (startup script)
5. Entrypoint starts Gunicorn WSGI server
6. Gunicorn loads app.py (Flask application)
7. Application initializes and loads configuration
8. Web server listens on port 11078
9. ✅ Application ready!

All of this happens AUTOMATICALLY. You just run the command.

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                      🛠️ USEFUL COMMANDS AFTER DEPLOYMENT
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Start app:           docker-compose up -d
Stop app:            docker-compose down
Restart app:         docker-compose restart
View logs live:      docker-compose logs -f
Check status:        docker ps
Health check:        curl http://localhost:11078/health
Full debug logs:     docker logs rdk-middleware-dashboard
List all images:     docker images
Remove app:          docker-compose down && docker rmi rpi4-app:latest

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                         ✅ NO MANUAL WORK NEEDED!
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

You NEVER need to:
   ❌ Extract tar file manually
   ❌ Run setup scripts
   ❌ Install dependencies
   ❌ Configure Flask app
   ❌ Start Gunicorn manually
   ❌ Edit configuration files (unless you want to customize)

Docker handles ALL of that automatically!
